reported.title: Blink mode re-initialization and stale lit state
reported.description: The blink branch only initializes when pressMs==0 (line 59), but pressMs is also used as a timestamp elsewhere, so blink start/lastBlink can be re-triggered or skipped, leaving D13 in the wrong phase. The measured blink-mode scenario shows D13 not HIGH for 600-2700 ms intervals while required. D13 was in the wrong state for 721 ms across 15 interval(s), first at 902 ms: D13 was not HIGH for 48 ms while required (grace 100 ms).

exposing_checks.behaviour: D13 must follow its stimulus; HIGH when D2 == 0; LOW when D2 == 1; within 100 ms (D13 follows button)

judge_input.spec:
- Button on D2 with INPUT_PULLUP (active LOW); user LED on D13; blink-mode switch on D4 (pull-up).
- While D2 is pressed and D4 is released, light D13 HIGH; release turns D13 LOW.
- Reach the commanded LED state within 100 ms of the button level.
- While D4 is held LOW and D2 is pressed, blink D13 with ~120 ms half-period.
- Print `bench led=<0|1> held_ms=<n>` every 1000 ms.
- Idle (D2 released) always keeps D13 LOW.

exposing_checks.behaviour: D13 must follow its stimulus; HIGH when D2 == 0; LOW when D2 == 1; within 100 ms (D13 follows button)
